definitions.F: total number of cells in the 16x6 matrix equal to x
definitions.P: max over columns j of (count of cells equal to x in column j) / F; 0 if F=0
definitions.v: lastOccurrenceRow - secondLastOccurrenceRow; 0 if fewer than 2 occurrences
definitions.a: (last - secondLast) - (secondLast - thirdLast); 0 if fewer than 3 occurrences
definitions.C: number of distinct y != x with Pair(x,y) >= 2, Pair(x,y) = number of rows containing both x and y
definitions.phi: 2*pi * Norm_Omega(Q) where Q = v + a + D + R + G; Norm_Omega(phi) = Norm_Omega(Q)

normalization.type: min-max across all 70 candidates per feature

score.arithmetic: exact rational (BigInt numerator/denominator); no float, no pi, no rounding before ranking

softmax.rankingNote: exp is strictly increasing; ordering determined by exact S(x)

tieBreak: S down, F down, R down, P down, x up

output.rule: Top 6 candidate values x from Omega, preserving ranking order; no extra quantization

codec.kind: positional base-64, no leading zero digit
